recipe.mark: a blotch: one loaded round brush set down and pushed about; one flat puddle of dilute pigment with a jagged coastline (big lobes plus a fine torn fringe); never an ellipse, never a directional stroke
recipe.edge: hard-dry: the puddle dries with a crisp, darker rim where pigment migrates to the edge and a paler bloom inside; no soft blending into neighbours; no drawn line
recipe.order: palest big puddles first; smaller, stronger puddles glazed over them (overlaps multiply into secondary colours); bare paper left between islands; a few spatter dots; white gouache sparkles with a halo last
recipe.paper: warm cream cold-press (#f5f1e6), coldpress tile at 0.1, paper tile at 0.05
recipe.subject rule: the focal subject is painted in the same puddles but a full value step darker than the ground, in the opposite temperature (warm magentas on a cool ground in the proof), with a bare-paper reserve round it

profile.summary: high key (mean L 0.84), contrast 0.23, 8 colours over 2%, chroma 0.064, no line, no measurable grain, edges 90% soft, no lattice; measured with the terminal window excluded
